_notes: Starter agronomic matrix for Central Iowa rotation crops. kc_ini/kc_mid/kc_end are FAO-56 single crop coefficients (Table 12, sub-humid climate, RHmin~45%, u2~2m/s) and feed the FAO-56 Penman-Monteith ETc calc. nitrogen_balance_kg_ha is the net soil N credit/debit left for the following crop, not gross fixation. Seasonal values are regional typicals for sanity-checking, not used directly in scoring once Kc x ET0 is computed from live NASA POWER data. typical_yield_t_ha and has_market_revenue feed the revenue_score proxy (see rotation_scoring.py) -- deliberately yield-only, no commodity price, since prices are too volatile/region-specific to cite responsibly (even USDA's own same-year figures were inconsistent across reports when checked). Sources: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56; USDA NRCS cover crop guides; Iowa State University Extension agronomy guides; USDA NASS for approximate multi-year-average yields.
_baseline_crop_note: Continuous monoculture most commonly practiced in this region today; used as the 'business as usual' comparison for impact metrics, not a scored candidate itself.

maize.source: FAO-56 Table 12; Iowa State Extension; yield is an approximate multi-year U.S. average order of magnitude (USDA NASS), not a specific year's figure
